title: VTC Directory — Images — Get — payload
description: Read the bytes of an image on a directory entry, where the caller's projection of that entry shows it. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

field.description: The image field: `avatar` or a community field of type `image`.

sha256.description: The image the caller expects, from the `CardBlobRef` it was shown. Where the field now holds another, the answer is `notFound`, so a reader never shows a picture under a card it did not come from.

Response.title: VTC Directory — Images — Get — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/directory/images/get/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/directory/images/get/0.1#response.

image.description: The image as stored, without `url` or `urlExpiresAt`.

data.description: The stored bytes, base64url without padding. Their SHA-256 is `image.sha256`.
